sn3.9:2.3: “Sir, here a grand sacrifice has been set up for King Pasenadi of Kosala. Bulls, bullocks, heifers, goats and rams—five hundred of each—have been led to the pillar for the sacrifice.
sn3.9:2.4: His bondservants, servants, and workers too do their jobs under threat of punishment and danger, weeping with tearful faces.”
